chapterInfo.content:
14
Yesu ne ɔkwan a wɔde kɔ Agya no nkyɛn
1 Mommma mo akoma nntutu! Monnye Onyankopɔn nni, na me nso, monnye me nni. 2Tenaberɛ pii wɔ m’Agya fie; sɛ ɛnte saa a, anka maka makyerɛ mo sɛ merekɔ makɔsiesie baabi mama mo? 3#Yoh 12.26; 17.24 Na sɛ mekɔ na mekɔsiesie baabi mema mo a, mɛba bio, na mabɛfa mo makɔ me ara me nkyɛn, na deɛ mewɔ no, mo nso moaba hɔ. 4Na faako a merekorɔ no, monim kwan no. 5Toma see no sɛ: Awurade, yɛnnim faako a worekorɔ, na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na yɛbɛtumi ahunu kwan no? 6#Heb 10.20; Mat 11.27; Yoh 11.25; Rom 5.1-2 Yesu see no sɛ: Mene kwan no, nokorɛ no ne nkwa no; obi mma Agya no nkyɛn, gye sɛ ɔnam me so. 7Sɛ monim me a, anka moahunu m’Agya no nso; na ɛfiri nnɛ monim no, na moahu no.
8Filipo see no sɛ: Awurade, kyerɛ yɛn Agya no, na ɛno ara dɔɔso ma yɛn. 9#Yoh 12.45; Heb 1.3 Yesu see no sɛ: Me ne mo wɔ hɔ dadadada yi, monhunuu me anaa, Filipo? Deɛ wahu me no ahunu Agya no, na adɛn nti na wose: Kyerɛ yɛn Agya no? 10#Yoh 12.49 Wonnye nni sɛ mewɔ Agya no mu, na Agya no nso wɔ me mu? Nsɛm a meka mekyerɛ mo no, ɛmfiri me ara me tirim na meka, na Agya a ɔte me mu no, na ɔyɛ ne nnwuma no. 11#Yoh 14.20; 10.25; 10.38 Monnye me nni sɛ mewɔ Agya no mu, na Agya no nso wɔ me mu; na sɛ ɛnte saa a, nnwuma no ara nti monnye nni! 12#Mar 16.19-20 Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ: Deɛ ɔgye me die no, nnwuma a meyɛ no, ɔno nso bɛyɛ, na ɔbɛyɛ akɛseɛ asene yeinom, ɛfiri sɛ me deɛ, merekɔ Agya no nkyɛn. 13#Yoh 15.7; Mar 11.24 Na biribiara a mobɛsrɛ no me din mu no, ɛno na mɛyɛ, na Agya no anya animuonyam, Ɔba no mu. 14#Yoh 16.23-24 Sɛ mobɛsrɛ biribi me din mu a, me deɛ, mɛyɛ.
Honhom Kronkron ho bɔhyɛ
15 # Yoh 15.10; 1 Yoh 5.3 Sɛ modɔ me a, monni m’ahyɛdeɛ so! 16#Yoh 14.26; 15.26; 16.7 Na me deɛ, mɛbisa Agya no, na wama mo Okyigyinafoɔ foforɔ, na ɔne mo abɛtena daa, 17#Yoh 16.13; 7.39 nokorɛ Honhom a wiase ntumi nnye no no, ɛfiri sɛ ɛnhu no, nanso ɛnnim no; na mo deɛ, monim no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔte mo nkyɛn, na ɔbɛtena mo mu. 18Merennya mo nnyanka, mɛba mo nkyɛn. 19#Yoh 16.16 Aka kakra na wiase nhu me bio; na mo deɛ, mohu me, ɛfiri sɛ mete ase, na mo nso mobɛtena ase. 20#Yoh 17.21-23 Da no ara mobɛhunu sɛ mewɔ m’Agya no mu, na mowɔ me mu, na mewɔ mo mu. 21#2 Ko 3.18 Deɛ ɔwɔ m’ahyɛdeɛ na ɔdi soɔ no, ɔno ne deɛ ɔdɔ me; na deɛ ɔdɔ me no, m’Agya bɛdɔ no, na me nso mɛdɔ no, na mayi me ho makyerɛ no.
22Yuda (ɛnyɛ Iskariot no) see no sɛ: Awurade, ɛyɛɛ dɛn na worebɛyi wo ho akyerɛ yɛn, na ɛnyɛ wiase? 23#Yoh 14.21; 13.34; Mmb 8.17; Efe 3.17 Yesu bua see no sɛ: Sɛ obi dɔ me a, ɔbɛdi m’asɛm so, na m’Agya bɛdɔ no, na yɛbɛba ne nkyɛn, na yɛabɛyɛ yɛn tenabea ne nkyɛn. 24#Yoh 7.16 Deɛ ɔnnɔ me no nni me nsɛm so; na asɛm a moteɛ no nyɛ me dea, na ɛyɛ Agya a ɔsomaa me no dea.
25 Mewɔ mo nkyɛn yi, na mereka mo yeinom; 26#Yoh 14.16 na Okyigyinafoɔ a ɔno ne Honhom Kronkron a m’Agya bɛsoma no me din mu no, ɔno na ɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ mo nnoɔma nyinaa, na ɔbɛkae mo deɛ maka akyerɛ mo no nyinaa. 27#Yoh 16.33; Flp 4.7 Asomdwoeɛ na mede megya mo, m’asomdwoeɛ na mede mema mo; ɛnyɛ sɛdeɛ wiase ma na mema mo. Mommma mo akoma nntutu, nso mommma no mmmɔ mo hu.
28 # Yoh 14.3; 14.18; 14.6 Moate sɛ meka mekyerɛɛ mo sɛ: Merekɔ na maba mo nkyɛn. Sɛ modɔ me a, anka mo ani bɛgye sɛ merekɔ Agya no nkyɛn, ɛfiri sɛ m’Agya no yɛ kɛseɛ sene me. 29Afei maka makyerɛ mo ansa na aba, na sɛ ɛnya ba a, moagye adi. 30#Yoh 12.31; Efe 2.2 Me ne mo renkasa pii bio; na wiase sodifoɔ no reba, na ɔnni tumi biara wɔ me so. 31#Yoh 10.18 Nanso meyɛ sɛdeɛ Agya no hyɛɛ me no, na wiase ahunu sɛ medɔ Agya no. Monsɔre mma yɛmfiri ha nkɔ!

pageProps.chapterText:
Mommma mo akoma nntutu! Monnye Onyankopɔn nni, na me nso, monnye me nni. Tenaberɛ pii wɔ m’Agya fie; sɛ ɛnte saa a, anka maka makyerɛ mo sɛ merekɔ makɔsiesie baabi mama mo? Na sɛ mekɔ na mekɔsiesie baabi mema mo a, mɛba bio, na mabɛfa mo makɔ me ara me nkyɛn, na deɛ mewɔ no, mo nso moaba hɔ. Na faako a merekorɔ no, monim kwan no. Toma see no sɛ: Awurade, yɛnnim faako a worekorɔ, na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na yɛbɛtumi ahunu kwan no? Yesu see no sɛ: Mene kwan no, nokorɛ no ne nkwa no; obi mma Agya no nkyɛn, gye sɛ ɔnam me so. Sɛ monim me a, anka moahunu m’Agya no nso; na ɛfiri nnɛ monim no, na moahu no.
Filipo see no sɛ: Awurade, kyerɛ yɛn Agya no, na ɛno ara dɔɔso ma yɛn. Yesu see no sɛ: Me ne mo wɔ hɔ dadadada yi, monhunuu me anaa, Filipo? Deɛ wahu me no ahunu Agya no, na adɛn nti na wose: Kyerɛ yɛn Agya no? Wonnye nni sɛ mewɔ Agya no mu, na Agya no nso wɔ me mu? Nsɛm a meka mekyerɛ mo no, ɛmfiri me ara me tirim na meka, na Agya a ɔte me mu no, na ɔyɛ ne nnwuma no. Monnye me nni sɛ mewɔ Agya no mu, na Agya no nso wɔ me mu; na sɛ ɛnte saa a, nnwuma no ara nti monnye nni! Mereka akyerɛ mo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ: Deɛ ɔgye me die no, nnwuma a meyɛ no, ɔno nso bɛyɛ, na ɔbɛyɛ akɛseɛ asene yeinom, ɛfiri sɛ me deɛ, merekɔ Agya no nkyɛn. Na biribiara a mobɛsrɛ no me din mu no, ɛno na mɛyɛ, na Agya no anya animuonyam, Ɔba no mu. Sɛ mobɛsrɛ biribi me din mu a, me deɛ, mɛyɛ.

Sɛ modɔ me a, monni m’ahyɛdeɛ so! Na me deɛ, mɛbisa Agya no, na wama mo Okyigyinafoɔ foforɔ, na ɔne mo abɛtena daa, nokorɛ Honhom a wiase ntumi nnye no no, ɛfiri sɛ ɛnhu no, nanso ɛnnim no; na mo deɛ, monim no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔte mo nkyɛn, na ɔbɛtena mo mu. Merennya mo nnyanka, mɛba mo nkyɛn. Aka kakra na wiase nhu me bio; na mo deɛ, mohu me, ɛfiri sɛ mete ase, na mo nso mobɛtena ase. Da no ara mobɛhunu sɛ mewɔ m’Agya no mu, na mowɔ me mu, na mewɔ mo mu. Deɛ ɔwɔ m’ahyɛdeɛ na ɔdi soɔ no, ɔno ne deɛ ɔdɔ me; na deɛ ɔdɔ me no, m’Agya bɛdɔ no, na me nso mɛdɔ no, na mayi me ho makyerɛ no.
Yuda (ɛnyɛ Iskariot no) see no sɛ: Awurade, ɛyɛɛ dɛn na worebɛyi wo ho akyerɛ yɛn, na ɛnyɛ wiase? Yesu bua see no sɛ: Sɛ obi dɔ me a, ɔbɛdi m’asɛm so, na m’Agya bɛdɔ no, na yɛbɛba ne nkyɛn, na yɛabɛyɛ yɛn tenabea ne nkyɛn. Deɛ ɔnnɔ me no nni me nsɛm so; na asɛm a moteɛ no nyɛ me dea, na ɛyɛ Agya a ɔsomaa me no dea.
Mewɔ mo nkyɛn yi, na mereka mo yeinom; na Okyigyinafoɔ a ɔno ne Honhom Kronkron a m’Agya bɛsoma no me din mu no, ɔno na ɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ mo nnoɔma nyinaa, na ɔbɛkae mo deɛ maka akyerɛ mo no nyinaa. Asomdwoeɛ na mede megya mo, m’asomdwoeɛ na mede mema mo; ɛnyɛ sɛdeɛ wiase ma na mema mo. Mommma mo akoma nntutu, nso mommma no mmmɔ mo hu.
Moate sɛ meka mekyerɛɛ mo sɛ: Merekɔ na maba mo nkyɛn. Sɛ modɔ me a, anka mo ani bɛgye sɛ merekɔ Agya no nkyɛn, ɛfiri sɛ m’Agya no yɛ kɛseɛ sene me. Afei maka makyerɛ mo ansa na aba, na sɛ ɛnya ba a, moagye adi. Me ne mo renkasa pii bio; na wiase sodifoɔ no reba, na ɔnni tumi biara wɔ me so. Nanso meyɛ sɛdeɛ Agya no hyɛɛ me no, na wiase ahunu sɛ medɔ Agya no. Monsɔre mma yɛmfiri ha nkɔ!

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!

app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
